concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-issuing-manage-card-data-reveal-card-details]] — 2026-09-15 Issuing Configuration API guide for role-gated encrypted PAN/CVC/expiry reveal to a cardholder app or website, with `panReveal` purpose and test/SDK example boundaries.
warnings: Revealing PAN/CVC makes plaintext card data available to the rendering client after decryption; the guide does not establish a particular implementation's data-handling compliance.
GET public-key SDK snippets use placeholder `string` purpose values despite the guide's explicit `panReveal` instruction.
